resources.string: A group must have 5 to 10 members to upgrade. It currently has %1$d.
Upgrade this group to a community? Its members and messages will be kept.
Only the owner can upgrade a group with 5 to 10 members.
This group is full. Upgrade it to a community to add members.
The group, its members, messages and attachments will be removed for everyone. This cannot be undone.
Could not delete the group. Only the owner or the last member can delete it. If deletion is in progress, tap Continue deletion to retry.
You are the last member. Choose Delete group in Members to close the group.
